business_summary: SBS Holdings, Inc. provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. It engages in logistics businesses, including the development of logistic solution services, 3PL global logistics, and in-house delivery of medical supplies, office equipment, furniture, and daily necessities. It also provides import/export and international logistics services, including customs clearance and forwarding, system design and development for warehouse and transportation operations, and marine container offerings. In addition, It operates logistics centers, provides truck transportation services, and offers three temperature zone food logistics services, freight forwarding services, warehousing services, tire and rubber product processing services, same-day delivery services, light cargo vehicle and general cargo transportation services, individual delivery services, and transportation, storage, loading, unloading, and packaging of bearings, automotive-related products, and precision machinery products. Further, it handles the transportation and delivery of electronic parts, automobile parts, and wires, as well as distribution processing. Additionally, it engages in logistics support businesses, such as waste treatment services, store acrylic fixture logistics, manufacturing services, packaging services, drum services, staffing, employment placement, warehouse and factory work contracting services, vehicle leasing, and the sale of fuel, tires, and insurance. It provides direct marketing planning, design, and operation, mail order services, and the leasing and sales of civil engineering and construction-related steel materials. Additionally, it develops logistics facilities, offers rental business and offers driving lessons. The company was formerly known as SBS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SBS Holdings, Inc. in April 2006. It was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: SBS Holdings, Inc.는 일본 및 해외에 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 물류 솔루션 서비스 개발, 3PL 글로벌 물류, 의료용품, 사무기기, 가구, 생활용품 사내 배송 등 물류 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 통관 및 운송, 창고 및 운송 운영을 위한 시스템 설계 및 개발, 해양 컨테이너 제품을 포함한 수입/수출 및 국제 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 물류센터를 운영하고 트럭 운송 서비스를 제공하며 3대 온도대 식품 물류 서비스, 화물 운송 서비스, 창고 서비스, 타이어 및 고무 제품 가공 서비스, 당일 배송 서비스, 경량 화물 차량 및 일반 화물 운송 서비스, 개별 배송 서비스 및 베어링, 자동차 관련 제품, 정밀 기계 제품의 운송, 보관, 하역 및 포장 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 전자부품, 자동차 부품, 전선 등의 운송 및 배송, 유통가공 업무도 담당하고 있습니다. 그 밖에 물류지원 사업도 영위하고 있습니다.
